en: Sepia-toned panoramic view of a coastal city with low buildings and open fields in the foreground. A large rectangular multi-storey building complex is prominent in the lower center, with more scattered structures leading toward the distant shoreline and hills. Greek and French captions appear at the top, along with the phrase "Souvenir de Crète" on the right. A website watermark "www.elia.org.gr" is printed at the bottom.
